europe_now.title: Romanian jet shoots down drone near Black Sea gas platform
europe_now.summary: A Romanian fighter jet intercepted and destroyed a drone near an offshore gas production platform in the Black Sea. Romania's president directly blamed Moscow for the drone incursion.

sources.headline: Romanian jet blasts drone near offshore gas platform, president blames Moscow

europe_now.title: China criticizes EU foreign subsidies regulation amid trade talks
europe_now.summary: Beijing has sharply criticized the European Union's new foreign subsidies regulation, linking the measure to ongoing trade negotiations. The dispute adds to growing friction over market access and regulatory standards between the two economies.

sources.headline: China slams EU foreign subsidies rules, links them to trade talks

top_stories.title: Extreme heat drives new research on climate health impacts in Europe
top_stories.summary: Scientists report significant progress in understanding how rising temperatures affect human health across Europe. Meanwhile, heatwaves in France have produced a record salt harvest in the Guérande region.

sources.headline: Extreme heat: 'We're really starting now to understand how global climate is impacting our health'
France’s heatwaves bring bumper salt harvest in Guérande

top_stories.title: Landmark EU case against Meta shifts focus to platform design
top_stories.summary: A major legal case against Meta is moving beyond content moderation to examine the platform's underlying design and infrastructure. The outcome could reshape how digital services are regulated under European law.

sources.headline: Landmark case against Meta: Focus shifts from online content to 'design and infrastructure'

top_stories.title: Major European powers condemn Israeli West Bank settlement plan
top_stories.summary: France, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Italy have jointly denounced Israel's proposed E1 settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank. The four nations warn the project undermines prospects for a two-state solution.

sources.headline: France, Germany, UK and Italy condemn Israel's 'E1' West Bank plan
France, Germany, UK and Italy slam Israel's 'E1' West Bank settler project

top_stories.title: Analysts warn internal turmoil threatens Ukraine's democratic resilience
top_stories.summary: Observers describe Ukraine as a genuine but fragile democracy facing significant internal political turmoil. Such instability risks weakening the country's political system as it continues to resist Russian aggression.

sources.headline: Ukraine a 'genuine', 'fragile' democracy: 'Internal political turmoil will weaken political system'

top_stories.title: Drone warfare escalates risks for global shipping lanes
top_stories.summary: The increasing use of drones in maritime conflicts is creating new threats to commercial shipping worldwide. The trend is linked to the shadow fleet operating in the context of the Ukraine war.

sources.headline: The drone war is coming for global shipping
